messages:
marcus: Thanks for joining todayquick follow-up on the wins/losses section. Short recap: wins = fast trial-to-prod migrations, transparent token billing; losses = KMS hookup delays, p99 ambiguity in demos, occasional hallucination on domain prompts. Questions and asks below.

emily: From GTM: customers that converted had a rehearsed migration playbook and clear rollback steps. Lost deals often cited security timelines and a need for an on-prem option.

viv: Product take: we need a canned one-pager that lists prerequisites, expected cost delta (example numbers), and perf SLOs. Also a short FAQ for AEs addressing KMS/SOC2 timelines.

nate: Eng note: short-term fixes: (1) a documented KMS onboarding checklist, (2) a fallback stability model for sensitive prompts, (3) p99 measurement for demo infra. Est: 2-4 weeks for a minimal rollout.

priya: CS will anonymize 3 closed-lost deals and attach the "what blocked" and "what would have changed their mind" notes. I can also add two success stories with migration steps.

marcus: Leadership ask: who owns (A) public-facing one-pager, (B) SLA packaging & legal signoff, (C) engineering canary plan for fallback/stability? Please @ owners.

emily: I will drive (A) with Priya and comms. Sam from legal will need to OK the SLA wording.

nate: I'll lead (C) and sketch a canary checklist. Need product to provide the domain prompts to validate.

viv: I'll coordinate with legal on SLA options and get back with a proposal for tiered p99 buckets.

triage-bot: Created ticket GH-204 in ops/playbooks: "All-hands follow-up - playbook + SLA proposal" assigned to emily, viv, nate.

marcus: Action recap: emily (one-pager + FAQ), viv (SLA writeup), nate (canary plan + metrics), priya (lost-deal redacts). Proposed 30m sync Friday 9am. React with :thumbsup: to confirm or suggest another time.
